Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the final analysis step by calculating the age of the directors relative to the film release years rather than comparing their absolute birth dates. The task asks "Which film whose director is younger," which implies comparing the directors' ages at the time of the query (or simply comparing their birth years directly to see who was born later). The Planner incorrectly calculated Reginald Le Borg's age as "46 at the 1948 release" and Hervé Bromberger's as "54 at the 1972 release" and concluded Le Borg was younger based on these specific ages. However, the question asks who is the younger director (i.e., who was born later). Reginald Le Borg was born in 1902, and Hervé Bromberger was born in 1918. Since 1918 is later than 1902, Hervé Bromberger is the younger director (by 16 years). The Planner's logic that "Joe Palooka... has the younger director" is factually incorrect because Le Borg (born 1902) is older than Bromberger (born 1918). The mistake was interpreting "younger director" as "younger age at the time of the specific film's release" instead of "younger chronological age (born later)."
